purpose: Controlled diagnosis of three previously observed LaMini failures; not an independent accuracy benchmark

supplementary.beam_search: num_beams=4 on six original prompts only
supplementary.candidate_likelihood: teacher-forced sum logP of Success./Failure./Unknown. including EOS on originals and compact_fields; normalized over these three strings only, not calibrated confidence

questions: Can actual and expected values be extracted separately?
Can equality be answered without domain labels?
Does clause/criterion order or simplification change the result?
Does beam search remove the error?
Does the parent checkpoint behave differently?
limitations: Diagnostic probes constructed after observing errors
Prompt changes are interventions on input behavior, not a mechanistic proof about weights or attention
Explanations are generated outputs, not faithful internal traces
No training or selection of an operational threshold
Given-comparison variant supplies part of the answer and is only a diagnostic oracle
